agent_discovery.disabled_reason: Nested perception primitive; direct Agent use requires a future typed mask-or-bounding-box initialization contract.
agent_discovery.description: Run a bounded FoundationPose registration and tracking operation for a known CAD model using synchronized RGB-D evidence and an explicit initialization mask. This is a finite nested perception Skill, not a continuously resident Provider.
when_to_use: A parent Skill has synchronized RGB-D frames, camera intrinsics, a known model ID, and a reviewed initialization mask.
Occasional high-cost CAD-model localization is needed inside a bounded workflow.
when_not_to_use: Continuous low-latency object tracking is required.
No explicit mask or reviewed bounding-box initialization is available.
A generic unknown-object visual description is sufficient.
side_effects: Loads a high-cost GPU model runtime for the bounded invocation.
May retain prepared estimators only within that invocation.
Releases owned estimator sessions and GPU caches when the invocation ends.

output_schema.description: No direct Agent result exists while this nested primitive remains undiscoverable and MANUAL_LOCAL_ONLY. A future direct adapter must replace this empty contract before discovery is enabled.

runtime_contract.execution_host_reason: The NVIDIA SDK and PyTorch CUDA runtime remain isolated in the FoundationPose Provider environment while the parent Skill owns the bounded job.

compatibility.removal_condition: Remove after all downstream consumers use the finite Skill contract and guarded hardware comparison is complete.
